source.name: Oklahoma Corporation Commission, RBDMS well data (nightly)

notes: Status codes from rbdms-wells-data-dictionary.xlsx: AC = Active, open wellbore (includes UIC injection wells); OR = orphaned; PA* = plugged. The OCC keeps the last operator on many OR wells; about 42% show 'OTC/OCC NOT ASSIGNED', treated as no operator. There is no date column, so the operator shown is the one on the current record.
